name: wheel-of-fortune
title: Wheel of Fortune
description: Prize wheel that spins and eases to a stop under a pin pointer. The winner is chosen before the spin (weighted random, or your own pick), so it always lands on the slice it reports. variant="drag" lets people grab and fling the wheel: a faster fling spins longer, in the direction it was thrown. The spin button sits in the centre, under the wheel or nowhere (drag only). A prize window opens over the wheel on landing, with the slice description and Spin again. Marquee rim lights chase while spinning, theme-token fills by default, custom slice and label colours, labels that never read upside down, and a screen-reader announcement. Honours reduced motion.
